Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tone street jewelry ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #141416, warm pale concrete #C6C3BD, warm off-white #F4F1EA and one cool silver highlight accent #BFC4C8; cool neutral tone; jewelry lightbox tent lighting, one narrow specular strip key from upper-left plus a bounce card on the shadow side, deep pool reflections on polished metal, crisp specular dots on bevel edges, controlled falloff, no blown highlights; modern geometric sans-serif with thin hairline keyline label boxes; consistent thin single-weight line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal label-led infographic elements; stable metal color, stable chain link proportions and stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no blown-out highlights or added sparkle, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks or QR codes. Photographed from a very low angle looking upward at 15 degrees, past the pendant toward the raised box lid, so the pendant reads as the dominant foreground mass and the chain falls in two clean runs over the box edge. The box carries no print, no letters and no marks. Product and box occupy 55-60% of the frame. 8K quality. Negative: no brand letters or wordmark anywhere, no QR code, no membership or price offer, no certificates, seals or award marks, no invented test data, no hands, no face, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges. Aspect 16:9, 2K.

provenance.notes: 源为一条详情页长图切成 13 片（panel-01 至 panel-13），主品为男士钛钢/不锈钢街头嘻哈风粗链吊坠项链：古巴链链身 + 通体金属浮雕铸造坠面，同款多 SKU 换坠型。已剥离：原图全部中英文营销文案（改为 {selling_point_*}/{callout_*} 占位）、收纳盒上的店铺字母印刷、末片二维码与入会免费信息、产品货号与促销档期日期、品质等级与防过敏等不可核验表述（尺寸数值一律脱敏为 {dimension_*}）、各 SKU 具体坠型题材（宗教符号、骷髅、生肖、动物头等不入模版，只保留可复用的暗调光盒金属微距体系）。佩戴镜全部改为颈下/锁骨裁切，无可识别面部。品类以图判定：L1 珠宝饰品 / L2 项链；本次下发的源夹标注为「饰品装饰品」，该名称不在内置 L1 清单内且与最终 L1 用词不同，故在此注明差异，L1/L2 严格采用 category-taxonomy.md 原文字符。与库内既有「夜光树枝爪镶吊坠项链」的区分：本款为通体金属铸造浮雕坠 + 粗古巴链、冷银暗调街头风，无夜光材质、无爪镶锆石，控光用 lightbox 压住金属高光（抛光带与倒角反光）而非宝石切面闪光，场景为黑丝绒/石面/木面平铺与颈下佩戴。
